mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id AS "ownerId", storage_key AS "storageKey", size_bytes AS "sizeBytes", content_type AS "contentType", checksum, status, created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM file_meta WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO file_meta s USING (VALUES ( #{id}, #{ownerId}, #{storageKey}, #{sizeBytes}, #{contentType}, #{checksum}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )) AS v(id, owner_id, storage_key, size_bytes, content_type, checksum, status, created_at, updated_at) ON s.id = v.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET owner_id = v.owner_id, storage_key = v.storage_key, size_bytes = v.size_bytes, content_type = v.content_type, checksum = v.checksum, status = v.status, updated_at = v.updated_at WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( id, owner_id, storage_key, size_bytes, content_type, checksum, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( v.id, v.owner_id, v.storage_key, v.size_bytes, v.content_type, v.checksum, v.status, v.created_at, v.updated_at )
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id AS "ownerId", storage_key AS "storageKey", size_bytes AS "sizeBytes", content_type AS "contentType", checksum, status, created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM file_meta WHERE status = #{status} AND updated_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
